name: bj-property-tfu
description: Prepare a Benin annual property-tax working paper for 2026 under the taxe fonciere unique, keeping ownership tax separate from rent income tax. Classify built and non-built property, identify the person liable, screen permanent and temporary exemptions, reconcile the assessed base and communal rate, and prepare statutory declaration and instalment schedules. This Guide covers the cadastral-identifier amendment and conditional 2026 late-charge relief. Two executable examples compare category-specific assessments and a change of use during an owner-occupied residence exemption. Local valuation instruments, an actual communal rate, authenticated payment and disputed property rights require separate evidence. Trigger phrases include Benin TFU, annual property tax, vacant land and principal residence exemption.
